footer.note: WatchingYou — a teaching build. Data resets whenever you drop the database.
onDisplay.title: Movies on Display
onDisplay.lede: What is showing in the halls right now, and in which language.
onDisplay.empty: Nothing is scheduled in this window.
gallery.ai.title: AI Catalog
gallery.ai.lede: Shorts generated with AI tools, published by their makers.
gallery.human.title: Human Craft
gallery.human.lede: Shorts filmed and edited by hand, published by their makers.
studio.title: Studio
studio.lede: Send us a short film, follow its review, and decide who gets to see it.
studio.originAttest: This decides which gallery it appears in. Declare it honestly — a reviewer checks.
studio.hoursLeft: hours left on the review window
security.title: Security desk
security.lede: Inspect each submission and file findings. Publishing is the admin's call.
security.confirmWatched: I watched this film end to end
admin.overrideNote: Security flagged this. Record why you are approving it.
account.verifyLede: We sent a six-digit code. Enter it to finish signing up.
home.hero.subtitle: Rent a film, book a seat for tonight, or put your own short in front of a reviewer.
home.title: The catalogue
home.lede: Search by title, director or plot. Filters and sorting run server-side, so the page you land on is the page you can link to.
home.emptyHint: Widen the genre, clear the search box, or turn off the in-stock filter.
sort.title: Title A–Z
cinema.title: Tonight in the halls
cinema.lede: Free seats are outlined, taken seats are filled. Picking is instant; the seat is only yours once you confirm.
cinema.emptyHint: An admin can add screenings once the catalogue has titles in it.
rentals.title: My rentals
rentals.lede: Late fees accrue daily after a six-hour grace period, capped at ten days of rental.
rentals.ledeSignedOut: Sign in to see what you have out.
rentals.signedOutHint: Your active, returned and overdue titles appear here once you are signed in.
rentals.emptyHint: Rent something from the catalogue and it shows up here straight away.
admin.whereLede: Live counts across rentals, and what your customers are actually watching.
admin.inventoryLede: Deleting is reversible: rows are flagged, never dropped, so a restore puts the title straight back on the shelf.
admin.col.title: Title
admin.screeningsLede: What appears on Movies on Display. Language is per performance, not per film.
admin.queueLede: Only submissions Security has already inspected reach this queue, and the report travels with them.
admin.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting on your decision.
chart.empty: Nothing to show yet — this fills in as customers rent and review.
error.catalogue: The catalogue could not be loaded.
error.rental: The rental could not be completed.
error.seatMap: That seat map is unavailable right now.
error.booking: The booking did not go through.
error.rentals: Your rentals could not be loaded.
field.videoFile: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV — max 512 MB
featured.title: On the front shelf
featured.lede: The best-reviewed titles. Drag, use the arrows, or the arrow keys.
cinema.gone: That performance is no longer listed. Pick another one below.
book.paymentLede: Visa or Mastercard. The number is never stored — only the brand and last four digits.
book.codeLede: We sent a six-digit code to your e-mail. The seats are held until you confirm.
book.showQr: Each seat has its own QR code — show the matching one at the door.
book.simulated: This is a simulated payment — no money moves.
account.resetLede: Enter your e-mail and we'll send a six-digit code.
account.resetDone: Password changed. You can sign in now.
account.resetSent: If that account exists, a code is on its way.
admin.usersLede: Grant roles, suspend accounts. You cannot demote the last admin or suspend yourself.
view.title: The view from your seat
view.unavailable: The 3D view could not start on this device.
admin.hallHint: Seat layout comes from the room
checkin.title: Ticket check-in
checkin.lede: Scan the QR code or type the reference.
admin.auditLede: Who did what, and why. Nothing here can be edited or removed.
globe.title: Who's watching
globe.lede: People who chose to appear. City level only — never a street.
globe.empty: Nobody is on the map yet.
globe.joinLede: Only your city is shown. Turn it off whenever you like — doing so deletes the location entirely.
globe.signedOut: Sign in to see the map.
map.unavailable: The map could not start on this device — everything else still works.
account.phoneHint: Add a number here to receive SMS codes. Changing it resets the confirmation.
account.smsConsole: If no SMS provider is configured, the code goes to the console.
error.notFound.title: Nothing here
error.notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page is gone. Carry on from the catalogue.
error.forbidden.title: Not yours to open
error.forbidden.body: Your account does not have permission for this page. If you signed in with the wrong one, sign out and try again.
error.unauthorised.title: Sign in first
error.tooMany.title: Slow down a moment
error.tooMany.body: That was a lot of attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
error.server.title: Something broke on our side
error.server.body: This one is not your fault. The reference below identifies it if you tell us.
refund.title: Return this ticket
refund.done: Refunded. The seats are back on sale.
refund.cancelled: This screening was cancelled — the full amount goes back.
refund.policyLine: Refundable while more than {window} hours remain, with {fee}% of the price kept. After that, no refund. If the screening is cancelled, everything comes back.
refund.no.AlreadyUsed: This ticket was used at the door.
help.title: Help Service
help.lede: A live conversation. Your message goes to the Security desk and the answer appears in this window.
help.greeting: Hello. What has gone wrong with a card, a ticket or your account? Write to us and we will answer.
help.pick: Pick a conversation on the left.
help.noPassword: Only your name and e-mail are visible. A password is never shown and never asked for.
